steps.content: You elude them at last—the shambling things that hunt these ruins. But the air remains troubled, thick with currents you cannot name.
The earth itself has forgotten its solidity. It moves beneath you now, like some viscous liquid.
Something inside you finally gives. The shattered streets lift and turn before your eyes, rearranging themselves with terrible purpose—an invisible architect completing its design.
Your legs forget their strength. You fall. And the darkness welcomes you home.
Time loses itself. When you finally wake, mist wraps everything—a veil between you and the world that was.

The scene breathes familiarity, but wrong. Broken doorframes sink into black mire, their surfaces now etched with uncanny patterns. Fallen signposts rise like craggy peaks. The concrete beneath you has dissolved into flagstones stretching endlessly. And within the fog, phosphorescence flickers.
At the corner you just passed, phantoms gather. Clusters of them. Standing still. Vacant.
Before you can comprehend, the phantoms converge. They drift toward you as one, bodies pressing together, mouths spilling familiar murmurs that coil through the air.
[Raise the field of view, and add some red visual effects.]
You step back. They rise to meet you in all directions. The ground births them, the fog exhales them. And now they scream, a chorus of shrieks that drive into your skull like spikes.

steps.speaker: Strange Phantoms
steps.content: You are... You are □□□□. To join... To join □□□□□, you must...
You turn and run. But the world is thick with them. Most merely exist, indifferent, unaware. Except—
Where they fall, they leave behind something worse. Phosphorescence pools. Stone cracks, weeping liquid light. And from the residue, limbs twist into malformed beings, shrieking as they lunge.
